questions.stem: Select the one FALSE statement among the following

options.label: A
options.text: The alveoli are lined predominantly by epithelial cells

options.label: B
options.text: Type II pneumocytes are a source of surfactant

options.label: C
options.text: Type I pneumocytes can divide to reconstitute type II pneumocytes after lung injury

options.label: D
options.text: Surfactant reduces surface tension and counteracts the tendency of the alveoli to collapse
